fields.name: row_id
fields.constraint: row_id >= 0; for data rows equals zero-based physical index; for padding rows equals Merkle leaf index

fields.name: timestamp
fields.constraint: timestamp >= 0; Unix seconds; 0 for padding rows

fields.name: features
fields.constraint: Q16.16 fixed-point; each element in int32 range; missing feature canonical value == 0

fields.name: missing_mask
fields.constraint: bit k set means feature k is missing; all 0xff for padding rows

fields.name: label
fields.constraint: data rows: label in {-1, +1}; padding rows: -1

fields.name: reserved
fields.constraint: reserved == 0; MUST be rejected if non-zero

field_packing.description: The 548-byte row blob is chunked into 31-byte little-endian integers, producing ceil(548/31)=18 field elements. 31 bytes < 31-byte BN254 field capacity, so each chunk maps to a unique field element without modular reduction ambiguity.
